description: Set one rule on the local signing policy. Rules: expiry, allowedChains, <chain>.maxValue, <chain>.allowedDestinations. Lists are comma-separated. maxValue caps the native value of one transaction and does not bound token amounts — an ERC-20 transfer carries value 0 — so use allowedDestinations to bound where tokens may go.
name: set_policy_rule
title: Set a Signing Policy Rule
